body:
i still think about the exact moment in august 2017 when i opened her page and there was… nothing. she'd wiped every single post. blank.

then three videos showed up. no caption, no song, no album name. just a snake's tail, glitching across a black screen, one after another after another. THREE of them 🐍

we had no idea reputation was days away. all we had was a snake and the loudest silence of her whole career — and honestly? still the most dramatic album rollout she has ever pulled off, i said what i said.

the challenge: open The Clue Web, find the reputation snake reveal, and tell me which of the three still gives you chills. reply below 👇

it lives under Threads on the site. 📷 the eras tour, inglewood 2023 — paolo villanueva (cc by 2.0), via wikimedia commons. swipe for the clue web.
